title: Methanol (Industrial Grade)
description: Industrial methanol for solvents, fuel, and chemical manufacturing.

details.longDescription:
Methanol (methyl alcohol, CH3OH, CAS 67-56-1) in industrial grade is a clear, colourless, highly flammable liquid supplied by Global Chemicals LLC at 99.85% minimum purity with water below 0.1%, boiling point 65 °C, flash point 11 °C and specific gravity 0.792, in 200 L drums, 1,000 L IBCs, ISO tanks and bulk from stock in Muscat and Rusayl Industrial Area. It is one of the highest-volume chemicals consumed in Oman, and the oilfield grade for continuous injection is listed separately under oilfield chemicals.

In oil and gas, methanol is the hydrate inhibitor injected at wellheads and along gas-gathering lines where a regenerable glycol system is impractical: it lowers the hydrate formation temperature of the gas-water mix, is not recovered, and so is dosed continuously by water rate and the required depression. In industry it is the feedstock for formaldehyde and the resins made from it, the methylating agent in MTBE and biodiesel (FAME) production, a solvent for coatings, inks and extraction, the base of windshield-washer and some antifreeze fluids, a denaturant for ethanol, a fuel and fuel additive, and a laboratory solvent in its finer grades.

Handling: methanol is toxic as well as flammable. Swallowing a small quantity, and prolonged skin contact or vapour inhalation, can cause blindness and death, and its flame is nearly invisible in daylight. Store it in closed carbon-steel or stainless tanks and drums in a ventilated, bunded, shaded area away from ignition sources and oxidisers; earth and bond during transfer; use explosion-proof pumps; wear butyl or nitrile gloves, goggles and, in poorly ventilated areas, organic-vapour respiratory protection. Never store it in a container that could be mistaken for drinking water. It is transported as UN 1230, Class 3 with a toxic subsidiary hazard; our drivers and tankers carry the matching documentation.

Every delivery ships with a certificate of analysis giving purity, water content, acidity and colour, a technical data sheet and a GHS safety data sheet in English, with Arabic on request. Global Chemicals LLC is JSRS-registered and ISO 9001:2015 certified.

Delivery is same day within Muscat, next day to Sohar, Salalah and Duqm, to the interior gas plants and fields by arrangement, and by road to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain with a certificate of origin. Request a quote with the pack type, monthly volume and delivery point.

faqs.question: What is industrial methanol used for in Oman?
faqs.answer: Industrial methanol (methyl alcohol, CH₃OH, CAS 67-56-1) is one of the highest-volume industrial chemicals in Oman's oilfield and process sector. Its primary uses are: hydrate inhibition in oil and gas pipelines (injected at wellheads and into subsea lines to prevent gas hydrate blockages), where Oman operators including PDO, OQ, and BP Oman consume hundreds of tonnes per month; solvent applications in paints, coatings, adhesives, and chemical synthesis; biodiesel production (methanol is the feedstock for transesterification of vegetable oil or waste fat to produce fatty acid methyl esters); formaldehyde production (a major downstream use globally, producing resins for MDF, plywood, and foam insulation); and as a fuel in industrial burners and fuel cells. Industrial methanol is highly toxic (10 mL can cause blindness, 30 mL can be fatal) and is distinguished from ethanol by the addition of denaturants in fuel ethanol — methanol has no safe consumption use. Global Chemicals LLC supplies ASTM Grade A technical methanol in bulk and IBC for Oman industrial applications.

faqs.question: How is methanol transported and stored safely in Oman?
faqs.answer: Methanol is classified as a flammable liquid (flash point 11°C, UN 1230, IMDG Class 3, Packing Group II) and toxic substance (Category 3 acute oral toxicity) requiring careful transportation and storage. In Oman, methanol transport by road tanker must comply with HAZMAT regulations under Oman's Royal Oman Police transport licensing requirements and ADR/GHS standards. Storage tanks must be grounded and bonded to prevent static electricity ignition, maintained at ambient temperature away from heat sources, equipped with flame arrestors on vent lines, and labeled with UN 1230 hazard placards. Secondary containment (bunded enclosure holding 110% of the largest tank volume) is mandatory for Oman PSAS (Public Authority for Safety and Standards) compliance. Personnel handling methanol must wear chemical-resistant gloves (butyl rubber), splash goggles, and lab coat; prolonged skin contact can cause dermatitis and dermal absorption. Emergency eyewash and shower stations are required within 10 seconds of any methanol handling area. Global Chemicals LLC provides methanol SDS and storage design guidance for Oman industrial customers.

title: Ethanol (Industrial/Denatured)
description: Industrial and denatured ethanol for solvents, fuel, and manufacturing.

details.longDescription:
Industrial ethanol (ethyl alcohol, C2H5OH, CAS 64-17-5) is supplied by Global Chemicals LLC in two strengths, 95% (the rectified azeotrope) and 99.5% anhydrous, denatured with methanol or isopropanol so it is excise-compliant and unfit for drinking, in 200 L drums, 1,000 L IBCs, ISO tanks and bulk from stock in Muscat and Rusayl Industrial Area. It is a clear, colourless, bio-based liquid with a boiling point of 78 °C, flash point 13 °C and specific gravity 0.789. The 70% sanitiser grade for food plants and laboratories is a separate product.

Which strength to order. The 95% grade is the general-purpose solvent and cleaner: it dissolves resins, shellac, dyes and essential oils, cleans electronics, optics and pharmaceutical equipment, and is the carrier in perfumes, colognes, body sprays, aftershaves and alcohol-based cosmetics made in Oman's industrial zones. The anhydrous 99.5% grade is for duties that cannot tolerate water: gasoline blending, water-sensitive synthesis and extraction, inks, adhesives and coatings where water would cloud the film or slow the cure, and as the intermediate for ethyl acetate, ethyl esters, acetaldehyde and diethyl ether. Ethanol is miscible with water and most organic solvents, evaporates cleanly and leaves no residue, and as a renewable alcohol it replaces petroleum solvents in formulations that market a bio-based content.

The denaturant matters for the application: methanol-denatured grades suit fuel and industrial duty; isopropanol-denatured grades are the usual choice for cosmetics and cleaning. State the end use when ordering and we supply the matching denaturant specification and the documentation customs and excise require.

Handling: ethanol is highly flammable (UN 1170, Class 3) with a flash point well below room temperature. Store drums closed, cool and bunded away from ignition sources and oxidisers, earth containers during transfer, and use explosion-proof pumps; the vapour is heavier than air. It is low in toxicity in use but dries skin, so wear nitrile gloves and goggles; denatured ethanol must never be ingested. Every delivery ships with a certificate of analysis giving strength, water, denaturant and colour, a technical data sheet and a GHS safety data sheet.

Delivery is same day within Muscat and Rusayl, next day to Sohar, Salalah and Duqm, and by road across the GCC with a certificate of origin. Request a quote with the strength, denaturant, pack type and monthly volume.

faqs.question: What is industrial ethanol and what are its key differences from beverage ethanol?
faqs.answer: Industrial ethanol (ethyl alcohol, CAS 64-17-5) is ethanol produced for non-beverage purposes, typically from petrochemical routes (ethylene hydration) or fermentation, and rendered undrinkable by addition of denaturants (methanol, isopropanol, bitrex, or other bittering agents) to prevent excise duty evasion. In Oman and GCC countries where alcohol regulation is strict, industrial and food-grade denatured ethanol is available for industrial use without the licensing requirements that apply to beverage alcohol. Industrial ethanol applications in Oman include: pharmaceutical and cosmetic solvent (sanitisers, skin preparations, fragrance extraction), surface cleaning and disinfection (70% ethanol solutions for general surface disinfection), solvent for adhesives, inks, and coatings, chemical intermediate, and fuel blending. Industrial ethanol must not be used for human consumption — denaturants are toxic and can cause serious harm. Denatured ethanol import and use in Oman must comply with Ministry of Commerce regulations. Global Chemicals LLC supplies industrial denatured ethanol with appropriate documentation for Oman industrial use.

title: Isopropanol (Industrial Grade)
description: Industrial isopropyl alcohol for cleaning, solvents, and manufacturing.

details.longDescription:
Isopropanol (isopropyl alcohol, IPA, 2-propanol, C3H7OH, CAS 67-63-0) is a clear, colourless, fast-evaporating alcohol supplied by Global Chemicals LLC in 99% anhydrous and 70% aqueous grades, boiling point 82 °C, flash point 12 °C and specific gravity 0.786, in 200 L drums, 1,000 L IBCs and bulk from stock in Muscat and Rusayl Industrial Area.

Which grade. The 99% grade is the cleaning and process solvent: it dissolves oils, flux, fingerprints and light greases, evaporates in seconds and leaves no residue, which is why electronics assemblers clean printed circuit boards and connectors with it, printers clean rollers and blankets, optical and precision workshops clean lenses and parts, and pharmaceutical and cosmetic plants use it for extraction, as a formulation solvent and for equipment wipe-down. It is also a drying agent that displaces water from parts, a coupling solvent in coatings and inks, the base of windshield-washer and de-icing fluids, and a carrier in aerosols. The 70% grade is the disinfectant: that dilution penetrates microbial cell walls better than pure alcohol and evaporates slowly enough to act, so it is the standard for hand sanitiser, surface disinfection in clinics, laboratories and food plants, and sanitising pumps, probes and tools. Both grades are miscible with water and most solvents.

Handling: isopropanol is highly flammable (UN 1219, Class 3), with a flash point below any Omani room temperature, and its vapour is heavier than air. Store drums closed, cool and bunded in a ventilated area away from ignition sources and oxidisers; earth and bond during transfer; use explosion-proof pumps; keep static in mind when wiping plastics. It defats skin and irritates eyes and, in high vapour concentrations, the airways; wear nitrile gloves and goggles and keep exposure within the workplace limit. Every delivery carries a certificate of analysis giving purity, water content and colour, a technical data sheet and a GHS safety data sheet. Reagent and HPLC grades are listed under laboratory chemicals.

Delivery is same day within Muscat and Rusayl, next day to Sohar, Salalah and Duqm, and by road to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain with a certificate of origin. Request a quote with the grade, pack type and monthly volume.

faqs.question: What is isopropanol (IPA) used for in Oman's industrial and cleaning sector?
faqs.answer: Isopropanol (IPA, isopropyl alcohol, 2-propanol, CAS 67-63-0) is a versatile solvent and disinfectant used widely across Oman's industrial, electronics, healthcare, and cleaning sectors. Primary applications include: electronics and semiconductor cleaning — IPA is the standard solvent for removing flux residues from circuit boards, cleaning optical components, and degreasing precision components because it evaporates without residue and is safe for most electronic components; surface preparation — IPA at 70–99% is used to clean metal, plastic, and glass surfaces before bonding, coating, or painting; industrial disinfection — 70% IPA (by volume) is an effective bactericide and virucide for surface sanitisation in Oman's food processing plants, pharmaceutical operations, and healthcare facilities; as a fuel additive and antifreeze for aviation fuel systems; and as a solvent in inks, adhesives, and cosmetics. IPA at 70% concentration is more effective as a disinfectant than 99% because the water content facilitates cell membrane penetration. Flash point is 11.7°C (Class IB flammable liquid). Global Chemicals LLC supplies IPA in 1-litre to IBC quantities for Oman.

faqs.question: Is isopropanol the same as isopropyl alcohol and IPA?
faqs.answer: Yes. Isopropanol, isopropyl alcohol, IPA and 2-propanol are names for the same chemical, (CH3)2CHOH, CAS 67-63-0; isopropyl rubbing alcohol is IPA diluted with water, typically to 70%.

title: N-Butanol (Industrial Grade)
description: Industrial n-butanol for coatings, plastics, and chemical synthesis.

details.longDescription:
n-Butanol (1-butanol, n-butyl alcohol, C4H9OH, CAS 71-36-3) is a clear, colourless four-carbon alcohol supplied by Global Chemicals LLC at 99.5% minimum purity, boiling point 118 °C, flash point 29 °C and specific gravity 0.810, in 200 L drums, 1,000 L IBCs and bulk from stock in Muscat and Rusayl Industrial Area. It evaporates far more slowly than ethanol or isopropanol and dissolves resins, oils and dyes strongly, which is the combination the coatings trade wants.

In paints and coatings it is the latent and tail solvent: it keeps nitrocellulose lacquers, amino and alkyd enamels and epoxy and urethane systems open long enough to flow and level, prevents blushing in humid Omani air, and improves the compatibility of resin blends. It is the alcohol in butyl acetate, the standard lacquer solvent, and in butyl acrylate, the monomer of acrylic emulsions and adhesives; it reacts with ethylene oxide to give butyl glycol ethers; and it is the alcohol half of dibutyl phthalate and other plasticisers. It is also a brake-fluid and hydraulic-fluid component, an extractant in pharmaceutical and antibiotic production, a textile auxiliary and a dye solvent. Formulators who need faster evaporation with similar solvency choose isobutanol; the FAQs on this page compare them.

Handling: n-butanol is a flammable liquid (UN 1120, Class 3) with a flash point just below the summer temperature of a Muscat warehouse, so store drums closed, cool and bunded in a ventilated area away from ignition sources and oxidisers, earth and bond during transfer, and use explosion-proof pumps. Its vapour irritates the eyes and respiratory tract at low concentration and it defats skin; wear nitrile gloves and goggles and keep exposure within the workplace limit. It is miscible with most solvents and partly soluble in water. Every delivery carries a certificate of analysis giving purity, water, acidity and colour, a technical data sheet and a GHS safety data sheet.

Delivery is same day within Muscat and Rusayl, next day to Sohar, Salalah and Duqm, and by road to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain with a certificate of origin. Request a quote with the pack type and monthly volume.

faqs.question: What is n-butanol used for industrially?
faqs.answer: The largest uses are butyl acrylate and butyl acetate production, solvent duty in paints, lacquers and coatings (excellent flow and blush resistance), plasticiser esters (DBP), and as a coupling agent in metal-cleaning and textile formulations. In the Gulf, coatings and construction-chemical formulators are the main consumers alongside oilfield solvent blends.

faqs.question: n-Butanol vs isobutanol — which do I need?
faqs.answer: n-Butanol (linear) is the standard for acrylate/acetate esters and most coating solvency specs; isobutanol (branched) is cheaper for some solvent and additive duties with faster evaporation. Check the ester or solvency specification of your formulation — our technical team can confirm from your recipe. We supply both.
